title: PostgreSQL
description: Connections, transactions, cache hits, sizes, locks and replication, with a user of the role pg_monitor.

address.title: Address
address.description: host:port of the server (loopback unless module_targets of agent.toml allows more).

role.title: Role
role.description: A login role (user) with the role pg_monitor and nothing more.

secret.title: Password
secret.description: Not needed with peer authentication over the socket.

tls.title: TLS
tls.description: off, verify (the certificate against the system's CAs or ca_file), no_verify (any certificate: encrypted, but to whoever answers). Empty: off on loopback and the socket, verify for any other address.

ca_file.title: CA file
ca_file.description: PEM file below module_file_prefixes to verify the server's certificate with instead of the system's CAs (tls verify).

auth.title: Authentication
auth.description: The weakest method taken: scram-sha-256 (only SCRAM, the server proves it knows the password), md5 (also md5), password (also the password itself, only over the socket or with tls verify).
